rationale: The Latin anchors *pittacium* (a patch/piece of cloth or metal), *commissura* (a joint/seam/patch), and *lamina* (a thin plate or sheet of metal) point clearly to a concrete sense of a metal *plate, patch, or sheet* — not to a chemical element (metallic_element.n.01) nor to an alloy (alloy.n.01). CLÚT here denotes a flat piece or patch of metal (cf. Modern English "clout nail" or "clout" as a metal plate), a sense not captured by either candidate synset.
